text:
Rin Park: quick design check 11 prototyped an inline threshold quick-edit vs the full modal we currently ship. fig: https://www.figma.com/file/example/inline-threshold-hybrid Evelyn Soto: saw it. inline is nice for fast ops (change number, save) but feels cramped if you need to change duration/aggregation/exclusions on the fly. mobile is especially tight. Theo Martin: agree. thought: hybrid pattern 11 inline for single-value quick edits, and an "Advanced" button to open the full modal for complex changes. keeps the fast path. Samir Jain: a11y note: when inline editor appears, it must receive focus and expose aria-live for validation errors. numeric inputs need clear labels and spin-button semantics. A11yBot: automated-a11y-check: 1976620000 11 focus-order-warning on inline editor open. Recommend setting aria-expanded and moving focus to the first input. Report: https://ci.internal/a11y/1976620000 Rin Park: good call. microcopy nit: placeholder currently "enter threshold". suggestion: "threshold value (e.g., 200)" to reduce ambiguous submissions. Evelyn Soto: UX suggestion: display the non-editable summary row as chips: [value] [duration] [agg]. Clicking the value turns into an inline field; clicking "duration" or "agg" opens modal for that setting. keeps context. Theo Martin: keyboard flow requirements: Enter = commit change, Esc = cancel and restore previous value, Tab should cycle through inline fields. After commit, show a lightweight, non-modal toast and set aria-live="polite" text so screen readers announce success. Samir Jain: sample aria markup for the row: ```
``` Samir Jain: keep hidden attribute when collapsed so it won't be in tab order; set aria-expanded on the toggle to reflect state. Also use aria-errormessage for validation. Rin Park: behaviour we decided on: - inline editor allowed only for numeric value edits + quick enable/disable toggle - any change to duration/aggregation/exclusions routes to the full modal with a preview of affected alerts - inline commits are optimistic but show a revert option in the toast for 5s Evelyn Soto: mobile: stack the chips vertically and collapse the advanced into a single chevron that opens a full-screen modal. mock incoming. Theo Martin: accessibility extras: add large hit targets (min 44px) for the inline controls and ensure color isn't the only state indicator (add an icon). Rin Park: action items: Rin - update figma with hybrid pattern and placeholder copy; Samir - compose a11y checklist and example aria snippets; Evelyn - mobile stacking mocks + truncation rules; Theo - keyboard/interaction spec and toast wording. I'll open the ticket and attach the new frames. :thumbsup: A11yBot: created ticket: design/1976620000 11 "threshold quick-edit: hybrid inline + modal pattern". ETA initial PR: 1976620078. https://tickets.internal/1976620000 Rin Park: thanks all 11 will ping when frames are updated.
